description.en: From the Ganges plain, the Gupta kings ruled much of northern India from about 320 CE. Chinese pilgrims and Sanskrit inscriptions describe the realm, and the astronomer Aryabhata worked in the capital region before Hun raids weakened the dynasty.
description.es: Desde la llanura del Ganges, los reyes gupta gobernaron gran parte del norte de la India desde hacia 320 d. e. c. Peregrinos chinos e inscripciones en sánscrito describen el reino, y el astrónomo Aryabhata trabajó en la región de la capital antes de que las incursiones de los hunos debilitaran la dinastía.
description.zh: 笈多诸王自公元320年前后起，以恒河平原为根基，统治印度北部大部分地区。中国朝圣者的记载和梵文铭文描述了这个王国；天文学家阿耶波多在都城一带工作，其后匈人的入侵削弱了王朝。

sources.citation: British Museum collection thesaurus, "Gupta" (c. AD 319/320 to 535), via PeriodO.
World History Encyclopedia. "Gupta Empire." Skandagupta (455 to 467) was the last of the sovereign rulers; the empire runs to c. 550.

note.en: The end is argued. Skandagupta, the last strong ruler, died in 467 CE. The British Museum ends the period in 535 and World History Encyclopedia in about 550, while later kings kept ruling a smaller realm.
note.es: El final se discute. Skandagupta, el último soberano fuerte, murió en 467 d. e. c. El Museo Británico termina el periodo en 535 y la World History Encyclopedia hacia 550, mientras reyes posteriores siguieron gobernando un reino menor.
note.zh: 终点存在争议。最后一位强势君主塞建陀笈多死于公元467年。大英博物馆把这一时期结束定在535年，《世界历史百科全书》则定在约550年，此后仍有国王统治着缩小的王国。

title.en: Chandragupta I becomes king and the Gupta line begins to expand
title.es: Chandragupta I se convierte en rey y la dinastía gupta empieza a expandirse
title.zh: 旃陀罗笈多一世即位，笈多家族开始扩张

sources.citation: British Museum collection thesaurus, "Gupta" (c. AD 319/320 to 535), via PeriodO.
World History Encyclopedia. "Samudragupta." Chandragupta I reigned 319 to 335 CE.

note.en: Sources give 319 or 320 CE for the start of Chandragupta I's rule.
note.es: Las fuentes dan 319 o 320 d. e. c. para el inicio del gobierno de Chandragupta I.
note.zh: 关于旃陀罗笈多一世统治的起点，资料给出的是公元319年或320年。

title.en: Samudragupta attacks the kings of the Ganges plain and sends armies south
title.es: Samudragupta ataca a los reyes de la llanura del Ganges y envía ejércitos hacia el sur
title.zh: 沙摩陀罗笈多进攻恒河平原的诸王，并派兵南下

sources.citation: World History Encyclopedia. "Samudragupta." Campaigns known chiefly from the Allahabad pillar inscription composed by Harishena.
World History Encyclopedia. "Gupta Empire." He conquered the rest of North India and added part of the south.

note.en: Almost everything comes from one praise poem, the Allahabad inscription. The campaign dates are unknown, and his reign is placed at 335 or 350 to 370 or 380 CE.
note.es: Casi todo procede de un solo poema de alabanza, la inscripción de Allahabad. Se desconocen las fechas de las campañas, y su reinado se sitúa entre 335 o 350 y 370 o 380 d. e. c.
note.zh: 几乎所有内容都出自一首颂诗，即阿拉哈巴德铭文。战事发生的年份不详，他的在位时间被定在公元335年或350年至370年或380年。

title.en: The Chinese monk Faxian travels in northern India and writes that criminals are fined and households are not registered
title.es: El monje chino Faxian viaja por el norte de la India y escribe que los criminales pagan multas y los hogares no se registran
title.zh: 中国僧人法显游历印度北部，记下罪犯只受罚款、民户无须登记

sources.citation: Legge, James (trans.) (1886). A Record of Buddhistic Kingdoms, being an account by the Chinese monk Fa-Hien of his travels in India and Ceylon (A.D. 399-414). Project Gutenberg #2124.
World History Encyclopedia. "Chandragupta II." Faxian visited India c. 399 to 414 CE during his reign.

note.en: Faxian does not name the king. He also says rebels could lose their right hands, and that people did not kill animals or drink alcohol, except the outcaste Chandalas.
note.es: Faxian no nombra al rey. También dice que los rebeldes podían perder la mano derecha y que la gente no mataba animales ni bebía alcohol, salvo los chandalas, marginados.
note.zh: 法显没有提到国王的名字。他还写到，叛乱者可能被砍去右手，百姓不杀生、不饮酒，只有被视为贱民的旃陀罗例外。

title.en: Skandagupta fights the Huns at the start of his reign, as his Bhitari pillar inscription records
title.es: Skandagupta combate a los hunos al comienzo de su reinado, como registra su inscripción del pilar de Bhitari
title.zh: 塞建陀笈多在位之初与匈人交战，比塔里石柱铭文对此有记载

sources.citation: Live History India. "The Attack of the Hunas (4th - 6th century CE)." Quotes the Bhitari pillar inscription of Skandagupta (c. 455 to c. 467) on his conflict with the Hunas.
World History Encyclopedia. "Gupta Empire." Skandagupta (455 to 467) prevented the invasion of the Huns.

note.en: The Huns here are the Indo-Hephthalites, probably the Kidarites. The year is the start of Skandagupta's reign, since the fight is placed early in it.
note.es: Los hunos aquí son los indohefalitas, probablemente los kidaritas. El año es el inicio del reinado de Skandagupta, ya que el combate se sitúa al principio de este.
note.zh: 这里的匈人指印度－嚈哒人，很可能是寄多罗人。年份取塞建陀笈多即位之年，因为这场战斗被认为发生在他在位早期。

title.en: Aryabhata, aged 23, completes the Aryabhatiya, a short Sanskrit text on mathematics and astronomy
title.es: Aryabhata, con 23 años, completa el Aryabhatiya, un breve texto sánscrito de matemáticas y astronomía
title.zh: 二十三岁的阿耶波多完成《阿耶波多历书》，这是一部讲数学和天文的梵文短篇著作

sources.citation: MacTutor History of Mathematics. "Aryabhata I." He finished the Aryabhatiya in 499 and gives Kusumapura, near Pataliputra, as his place of work.
EBSCO Research Starters. "Aryabhata the Elder." The book says it was written in 499 when he was twenty-three.

note.en: The 499 date comes from the text itself. Scholars argue about whether Kusumapura was his birthplace or only where he worked.
note.es: La fecha de 499 procede del propio texto. Los estudiosos discuten si Kusumapura fue su lugar de nacimiento o solo donde trabajó.
note.zh: 499年这一年份来自书中自述。学者争论的是，库苏玛普拉是他的出生地，还是只是他工作的地方。

title.en: Huna rulers Toramana and Mihirakula push deep into northern India as Gupta power fades
title.es: Los gobernantes hunos Toramana y Mihirakula penetran en el norte de la India mientras el poder gupta se debilita
title.zh: 匈人首领头罗曼和摩醯逻矩罗深入印度北部，笈多势力随之衰退

sources.citation: Live History India. "The Attack of the Hunas (4th - 6th century CE)." Mihirakula (515 to 540); the Hunas held territory from Bamiyan to Gujarat in the declining years of the Gupta Empire; Toramana's Eran inscription.
World History Encyclopedia. "Gupta Empire." After Skandagupta's death the dynasty was torn by internal conflict and plagued by Hun attacks.

note.en: The dates are those given for Mihirakula's reign. Sources disagree on when the Gupta empire ended and how much the Huns caused its decline.
note.es: Las fechas son las que se dan para el reinado de Mihirakula. Las fuentes discrepan sobre cuándo terminó el imperio gupta y cuánto contribuyeron los hunos a su declive.
note.zh: 这里的年份是学界给出的摩醯逻矩罗在位时间。关于笈多帝国何时结束，以及匈人对其衰落起了多大作用，资料说法不一。

text.en: Aryabhata gave the circumference of a circle with diameter 20,000 as 62,832, which makes pi about 3.1416.
text.es: Aryabhata dio 62 832 como la circunferencia de un círculo de diámetro 20 000, lo que da un valor de pi de unos 3,1416.
text.zh: 阿耶波多给出直径为两万的圆周长约为62832，由此得到的圆周率约为3.1416。
